name: Absolute Beginner? Start Here
instructions: Revisit the fundamentals with fresh eyes now that a week of practice is behind you -- small technique details make more sense once your fingers have some experience.
Check your grip, thumb position, and posture again; bad habits are much easier to fix now than after months of practice.
Notice which chords or motions from week one now feel easier than they did on Day 1.
Watch today's video, part of a free 10-day beginner starter course.
